description: Mid-tempo (~76bpm), bright, moderate-energy pop/electronic groove. Versatile default for upbeat, everyday content that isn't strongly happy or serious either way.
Fast (~152bpm), bright, driving electronic beat at a lower background volume. Good for quick-cut, high-energy trend content where narration still needs headroom over the beat.
Fast (~128bpm house/EDM tempo), loud, bright dance-pop energy. Best for hype, exciting, high-energy topics - the most 'trend-vibe' track of the set.
Very fast, loud, driving pop energy - catchy and high-tempo. Good for excited, fast-paced storytelling or anything meant to feel frantic/fun.
Moderate-tempo (~86bpm), loud, but tonally darker/deeper than the others (lower spectral brightness). Less cheery, better for steady, confident, slightly more serious or business-like content.
Long (4+ minute) loop, moderate tempo, mid/dark tone, unobtrusive. General-purpose background that won't demand attention - good default for longer or more narrative reels.
Fast (~152bpm), the loudest/punchiest track in the set. High-intensity and driving - good for hype, action, or anything that should feel urgent.
Fast (~144bpm), loud, bright, upbeat groove. Energetic and celebratory - good for exciting, triumphant, or feel-good moments.
Slower, laid-back tempo but still loud and reasonably bright. Confident/cool rather than frantic - good for content with swagger that doesn't need to feel rushed.
Lo-fi, warm, quiet, moderate tempo (by far the darkest/softest track in the set). Chill, relaxed, cozy - best for reflective, calm, or low-key topics.
